moody-center.calendarUrl: https://moodycenteratx.com/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events (official Tribe Events REST API for moodycenteratx.com/events)
moody-center.note: Re-read via the venue's own WordPress/Tribe Events REST API (more complete than the paginated HTML page, which only rendered 12 of the 35 events). Confirms Crossroads Guitar Festival on Sep 26-27, Teddy Swims Oct 28, Disney Worlds Collide Dec 4, Trans-Siberian Orchestra Dec 9, etc. Basketball games are on the same calendar (mixed with concerts) but are not music.

moody-amphitheater.note: Webflow site, server-rendered event cards (no further pagination found in the static HTML). Only 12 shows listed, running Sep 23 through Nov 7, 2026 (Steve Lacy). Several real, independently-confirmed shows in this window (Glow in the Park benefit, Dia de los Muertos, Morning Glories Diwali) are not on this list at all -- likely third-party/private bookings in Waterloo Park that the venue's own marketing site doesn't carry.

germania.note: Only 4 upcoming shows listed (Babymetal 9/26, Five Finger Death Punch 9/28, $uicideboy$ 10/13, beabadoobee 10/17) -- cross-checked against Ticketmaster's own venue page, which shows the identical 4 events, so this is a genuinely short near-term calendar, not a scraping miss. Halestorm is on the bill as Babymetal's support (per Ticketmaster lineup) but not named on either site.

stubbs.note: Extracted from the page's embedded JS calendar array (start/title pairs), which is more complete and precisely dated than the visible HTML cards on stubbsaustin.com's homepage. Covers Sep 27, 2026 through Nov 25, 2026 continuously, plus one outlier in Apr 2027. Two real, independently-confirmed Nov 9 shows (6LACK, David Shabani) are missing from this list entirely -- the calendar jumps from Nov 8 straight to Nov 13.

scoot-inn.note: Extracted from JSON-LD MusicEvent blocks on the homepage, which name only the headliner (no support acts). Covers Sep 27 through Nov 28, 2026. Several cluster items were support acts for shows that ARE on this list under the headliner's name (Gifted Hands/Dax, Madelline/EMEI, Night Moves/The Afghan Whigs); one (Lenny Pearce) is a real show but at the wrong venue in the source data (belongs to Stubb's, not Scoot Inn).
